name: mcp.calendar.list
rests_on: agents-calendar CLI list VEVENTs; --from/--to prefer local wall time plus an optional IANA timezone (explicit timezone, else CALDAV_TIMEZONE or timezone in the credentials file, else the calendar's CalDAV calendar-timezone, else the host zone, else UTC); a date is 00:00 in that zone; Z and numeric offsets stay absolute; each event includes dtstart_local (with an offset when timed), timezone, and all_day; timed dtstart stays the UTC instant; all-day fields are dates and dtend is exclusive; JSON array sorted by start time, so keep the range narrow; a DST gap or ambiguous naive bound errors, retry that instant with an explicit offset; exit 0 = listed

from.description: Range start as local wall time (2026-11-29T16:00:00) or a date (2026-11-29, meaning 00:00 in the resolved zone). Do not convert wall time to UTC first. Z or a numeric offset is an absolute instant. A gap or ambiguous time returns an error; retry that instant with an explicit offset. Returns a JSON array sorted by start time; keep the range narrow. Show dtstart_local, timezone, and all_day. Timed dtstart is the UTC instant. All-day fields are dates and dtend is exclusive.

to.description: Range end, same rules as from. A date is 00:00 in the resolved zone. Show dtstart_local, timezone, and all_day.

timezone.description: Optional IANA zone for naive bounds and for dtstart_local, for example Europe/Berlin. When omitted: CALDAV_TIMEZONE or timezone in the credentials file, then the calendar's CalDAV calendar-timezone, then the host zone, then UTC.

calendar.description: Calendar collection name or URL to query (optional, defaults to all)
